# ADR-3099: A09: Silent auth failure path for login family 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unaudited failures hide credential attacks.

## Decision

Identity services MUST NOT use a silent auth failure path for login family 3 (A09-3).

## Consequences

Failures emit structured security events.
